estimand.delta_s: p_never,s - p_principal,s; observed binary outcome risk per admission within score level s
estimand.delta_w: sum over prespecified population common support S* of pooled-record weights w_s times delta_s
estimand.w_s: population pooled record frequency for score s conditional on S*; estimated-weight main estimator uses sample pooled record counts
estimand.main_variance: full estimated-weight patient-cluster influence function, contributions summed within patient, finite-sample M/(M-1) correction
estimand.fixed_weight_sensitivity: same truth weights held fixed and the weight influence-function term omitted; reported separately from main A/B/C
estimand.support_rule: S* is supplied by each simulation design; missing a positive-probability target cell is target_support_lost
estimand.target_support_lost_metrics: A/B/D may emit observed-common-support intervals and are marked off-target; C withholds the population-target interval and retains a labelled observed-supported point estimate

policies.A: No refusal rule; emit a finite estimated-weight interval on observed common support, including a zero-width interval when the estimated variance is zero.
policies.B: Emit only when every score-by-definition cell on the prespecified target support has at least 10 records per definition; a missing target cell is below threshold.
policies.C: Full v2 audit: prespecified support stability; at least 20 distinct patients overall and per score-by-definition cell; at least 20 records per score level and 10 per score-by-definition cell; nondegenerate outcomes in every target cell; at least 20 usable patient-bootstrap replicates.
policies.D: Supplementary matched-threshold ablation: at least 20 distinct patients per observed score-by-definition cell and exact nondegenerate outcomes; no bootstrap or prespecified-support stability gate.
policies.legacy_variance_comparator: A policy using the same estimated-weight point estimate but the legacy fixed-observed-weight influence function; not part of the primary A/B/C rule comparison.
policies.fixed_weight_sensitivity: A policy using the known population pooled-record weights as fixed reference weights; the target equals the main estimand but the estimator omits weight estimation by design.

bootstrap_gate.seed_rule: outer scenario seed plus replicate index namespace; bootstrap does not alter outcome draws

metrics.conditional_coverage: covered intervals divided by emitted intervals whose observed support equals S*
metrics.conditional_observed_weight_truth: per-replicate sum of observed pooled-record weights times known delta_s, computed only when observed common support exactly equals S*; null when support is lost
metrics.conditional_observed_weight_coverage: separately labeled diagnostic coverage against conditional_observed_weight_truth; it does not replace population-truth coverage and is not computed when support is lost
metrics.emission: intervals emitted divided by all outer datasets
metrics.unconditional_missed_interval: emitted interval that fails to cover the population truth OR is emitted on changed support, divided by all outer datasets
metrics.width: median and mean 95% interval width among emitted intervals on target support
metrics.paired_comparisons: same simulated dataset is evaluated by every policy; report paired differences and paired Monte Carlo SE for emission, unconditional misses, and conditional coverage
metrics.per_level_conditional_coverage: covered emitted pointwise CIs divided by emitted CIs among replicates where that score-specific estimand is population-defined
metrics.per_level_output: emitted shared-function CIs divided by all 1000 replicates for that population-defined score-specific estimand
metrics.complete_family: all pointwise CIs for every population-defined group-risk cell and every common-support delta_s are emitted and cover; report as descriptive complete-family diagnostic only

inference_validation.invocation: direct call with all configured score levels after renaming simulated y to outcome

estimands.group_risk: score- and definition-specific observed binary outcome risk per admission; defined only when the configured joint group-score probability is positive
estimands.delta_s: risk_never,s - risk_principal,s; defined only when both configured group-score probabilities are positive

support_eligibility.common_support: both group-score population probabilities are positive
support_eligibility.partial_support: summarize group risks only for positive-probability cells and delta_s only on positive-probability common support
support_eligibility.no_common_support: no delta_s estimand or complete all-CI family; report explicit ineligibility and refusals without inventing a contrast

inference_validation.coverage: conditional pointwise coverage among emitted intervals for defined estimands; use the returned rounded CI arrays as emitted by the shared function
inference_validation.bias: point-estimate bias in percentage points among replicates with the relevant defined cell(s) observed; separately report bias among CI-emitted replicates
inference_validation.family_diagnostic: complete output and simultaneous containment among all emitted pointwise group-risk and delta_s intervals for a design's defined cells; descriptive only, no 95% familywise claim
inference_validation.random_stream: for design index j and replicate r starting at 0, default_rng(seed + j*1000003 + r*10007), same Gaussian-copula DGP generator as the frozen benchmark
